description: Visitor analytics for apps owned by Starter, Maker or Max subscribers; collaborators use the app owner's plan. Free/anonymous apps have no visitor statistics. Cookie-free, server-side access-log stats with no setup: unique visitors, sessions, bounce rate, top pages, referrers, entry pages, countries, devices, browsers and OS. Bots/scanners are excluded and reported as totalBotRequests/totalScannerRequests. `days`: 1-90 (default 7). Updates every 15 minutes; new apps may initially show zero.
name: percher_analytics
